description.value: Little Mexico Cantina is a full-service Mexican restaurant and bar in the Steveston village area of Richmond, offering house-made tortillas, a wide taco selection, and a full bar with daily happy hour. The Chatham Street location puts it within easy reach of cyclists riding the popular Fraser River dyke trail network. A broad appetizer menu and online ordering make it a flexible stop for groups of varying sizes.

enrichment_extras.reasoning: Website content confirms a functioning sit-down Mexican restaurant and bar at #150 - 3131 Chatham Street, Richmond, matching OSM address, phone, and URL exactly. The 'ORDER ONLINE' navigation link and menu page confirm takeout capability; the menu lists multiple explicit vegetarian-labelled items confirming that amenity. No website or OSM evidence mentions bike parking, water refill, washrooms, Wi-Fi, or any cycling-specific infrastructure, so those fields remain null per absence-of-evidence rules.
enrichment_extras.recommended_status_reason: Active full-service restaurant and bar near the Steveston dyke cycling network, with confirmed takeout and vegetarian options — a practical and welcoming stop for touring cyclists in Richmond.
